chunks: Which of the favours of your Lord will then both of you deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the refrain 'Fabi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the dual pronoun 'kumā' is often interpreted as addressing both Jinn and humans, or specifically the two types of humans: believers and disbelievers. This refrain serves as a rhetorical challenge to deny any of God's countless blessings, emphasizing the inescapable reality of divine favor. The repetition underscores the abundance of blessings and invites reflection on their source.
